title: Selected Bit Prefix
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be a Boolean list, and let $m$ be a natural number. Define a Boolean string of length equal to the number of selector types for $M$ by taking, at index $j$, the $j$th bit of $y$ when $j<m$, using false if that index is beyond the end of $y$, and taking false when $j\ge m$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
